content: अहत {%a.%} .²1 Not hurt or struck, uninjured; अजीतोऽहतो अक्षतोऽध्यष्ठां पृथिवीमहम् <ls>Av. 12. 1. 11</ls>. .²2 Unbeaten (as cloth in washing). अहतं वासः परिधत्ते <ls>Ts.</ls> .²3 Unwashed, new बभूवुस्ते भृशं प्रीताः सर्वे चाहतवाससः <ls>Rām. 2. 91. 64</ls>. .²4 Unblemished, unsoiled. .²5 Not frustrated or disappointed (as hopes <ab>&c.</ab>) .²6 Not beaten (as a drum) अहतायां प्रयाणभेर्याम् <ls>K.</ls> .{@-तम्@} An unwashed or new cloth; <ab>cf.</ab> अप्रहत.
